scope: Verified straight type-5 input mapping, fields and analytical point-drag encounter; not full catalog or ASWING executable parity.

provenance.scope: Pinned public type-5 input examples, retained outside source/local distributions. Zero spanwise slopes only; no other parameter maps are inferred.

documentation.section: README test scenario: onset -15, gradient 15, peak 3

ambiguities: The older Avoni amplitude comment says 0.01*30 m/s but the numeric record is 3. The numeric value is retained without correction.
Examples contain either one or two unused zero records. Nonzero trailing values and nonzero slopes are rejected until their semantics are established.

cases.name: wingloop.gust/profile
cases.text:
5 ! vertical one-minus-cosine gust
-15 ! Earth X at onset [input L]
0 ! spanwise slope
15 ! onset-to-peak H [input L]
3 ! peak Earth-Z velocity [input L/T]
0 ! unused parameter
